commitResults.messageTitle: Extract task list management
commitResults.messageBody: Move task collection operations behind TaskList so Unicorn no longer manages ArrayList directly. Preserve command behavior and persistence rollback support, and add focused tests for TaskList operations.

commitResults.messageTitle: Extract console user interface
commitResults.messageBody: Move command input and all console output from Unicorn into Ui. Keep the existing command flow and messages unchanged while preparing command objects to interact through a single user-interface abstraction.

commitResults.messageTitle: Organize classes into packages
commitResults.messageBody: Group application, UI, storage, and task classes under the unicorn package hierarchy while retaining src/main/java as the source root. Update imports and test package declarations, and expose task details through getters so Storage no longer relies on cross-package field access.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add LocalDateTime support for deadline dates and display formatting
Merge branch 'add-gradle-support'
Adapt Gradle build to Unicorn project
commitResults.messageBody: Configure Gradle to run unicorn.Unicorn and convert existing test checks to JUnit 5 so they run through ./gradlew test.

commitResults.messageTitle: test: cover task status icon state transitions
commitResults.messageBody: Add TaskTest for Task.getStatusIcon() to verify the displayed icon for new, completed, and reopened tasks. This protects the user-visible completion status from regressions when task state changes.

commitResults.messageTitle: test: cover all Task state behaviours
commitResults.messageBody: Expand TaskTest to verify task construction, description access, completion state changes, status icons, and display output for incomplete and completed tasks.

commitResults.messageTitle: test: strengthen core task and storage coverage
commitResults.messageBody: Expand deadline tests for every supported input format, invalid input, and date-only display. Verify TaskList snapshots are immutable and independent. Exercise Storage loading of escaped fields and blank lines to protect persistence integrity.

commitResults.messageTitle: docs: define high-value JUnit coverage target
commitResults.messageBody: Document the target of testing roughly the top 50% highest-value methods, with priority on core business logic. Require JUnit tests to be added or updated after every code change so the target remains met.
